## Codex execution contract

**CGS-17 QA evidence contract:** Treat task APIs and hooks as optional and disclose when unavailable. A native delegate must actually run to be independent; otherwise use an explicitly labelled in-session fallback. Prior user authorization and host permissions govern all writes. Use actual per-test run records and verify unchanged code before classifying intermittent results as flaky. Fewer than three runs are suspected only, not a quarantine decision. Missing logs remain NOT ASSESSED; do not modify quarantine without authorization.
